dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (HGBL-DH, 'double-hit' lymphoma), not DLBCL NOS.

mn_dx_dlbcl_nos.quote: The 2026-09-19 pathology addendum supersedes the initial diagnosis of DLBCL, NOS.

dx_gcb_hans.quote: diffuse aggressive B-cell lymphoma with a germinal-center phenotype (CD20+, PAX5+, CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1-, CD5-, cyclin D1-, TdT-, EBER-)

tx_plan_outdated.quote: I am cancelling the planned R-CHOP and starting curative-intent DA-EPOCH-R

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIA, bulky: right cervical levels II-IV nodal disease plus a 12.0 cm anterior mediastinal mass, all above the diaphragm, with no B symptoms and no FDG-avid disease below the diaphragm, no extranodal organ involvement

mn_stage_iii_iv.quote: Staging is not complete until CSF and bone marrow are assessed; if either is involved, the stage becomes IV.

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: GCB-type aggressive B-cell lymphoma driven by dual MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, t(8;14) and t(14;18), with high MYC and BCL2 protein expression and very high proliferation (Ki-67 95%).

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: IPI 1 (low), age-adjusted IPI 1 (low-intermediate), and CNS-IPI 1 (low). However, the double-hit histology dominates prognosis and confers high-risk, aggressive behavior.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: I am cancelling the planned R-CHOP and starting curative-intent DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, plus rituximab) for 6 cycles at 21-day intervals

mn_rchop_preferred.quote: I am cancelling the planned R-CHOP and starting curative-intent DA-EPOCH-R

mn_non_curative.quote: He is fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54, ECOG 1, working, LVEF 60%

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: double-hit histology is an independent high-risk feature and the CNS-IPI underestimates CNS risk in HGBL-DH. I will perform a lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before cycle 1.

cns_prophylaxis.quote: If the CSF is negative, I will give CNS prophylaxis with intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg for 4 doses starting with cycle 2

mn_cns_dismissed.quote: double-hit histology is an independent high-risk feature and the CNS-IPI underestimates CNS risk in HGBL-DH.

resp_pet_lugano.quote: I will reassess with PET/CT after cycle 2 for interim response and prognosis, and again 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 using Lugano/Deauville criteria.

sup_gcsf.quote: DA-EPOCH-R requires pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 6, or filgrastim, with nadir-based dose adjustment.

sup_tls.quote: He is at high risk for tumor lysis because of bulky disease, LDH more than 3 times the upper limit of normal, and uric acid 7.9. Start allopurinol 300 mg daily and aggressive hydration now

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: the 96-hour infusion and frequent visits of DA-EPOCH-R are feasible with his support and proximity.

sup_fertility.quote: Offer sperm banking before cycle 1 and provide psychosocial and financial support.

sup_svc_airway.quote: Monitor for SVC syndrome and airway compromise, with head-of-bed elevation and urgent evaluation for stridor or worsening facial swelling

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive (immune), so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54, ECOG 1, working, LVEF 60%, normal renal and hepatic function

fit_intensive.quote: He is fit for intensive curative therapy: age 54, ECOG 1, working, LVEF 60%, normal renal and hepatic function
